name: Stafford Slim 100 — Staging Test
description: Staging-architecture activation test tenant. Same data as stafford-slim-100 but routes through the staging layer: integration/adapter.json sets adapterType=staging-read, so SyncService reads from staging/<tenant>/current/raw/ instead of the flat files.
